audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows contradicted their own whys: row 3 read Shen while whys[3] says 'Levels 4-5 flatten out', row 6 read Shen while whys[6] says 'Late game evens out', and row 4 read Wukong while whys[4] says Shen's global R blanks your all-in. The packet also logs the chart as contradicting a 52.32% Wukong win rate.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Skill, Skill, Shen, Skill, Shen, Shen, Skill]; the mirror audit states Wukong takes Level 1, so row 0 stays Wukong and the remaining rows are taken from the packet.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4 and 6 flipped in both layers as one atomic group: Skill, Shen, Skill, with ratings moved to match. Final chart Wukong / Skill / Shen / Skill / Shen / Shen / Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 row was written as a Wukong spike on generic Cyclone text; Shen's spike at 6 is Stand United, and no cooldown was ever given.
audit.why: Kit: Stand United (R) 200/180/160s, 35000 range, flagged channel and global. Twilight Assault (Q) 8/7.25/6.5/5.75/5s, 400 range, max-health damage. Spirit's Refuge (W) 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s. Shadow Dash (E) 18/16/14/12/10s, 600 range.
audit.corrected: Level-6 row now names Stand United at 200s; the cooldown block carries Shadow Dash 18s, Spirit's Refuge 16s and Stand United 200s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors plus one missing interaction. (1) 'his shield (Q) blanks your Q trade' — Q is Twilight Assault, a max-health blade attack; the shield is the passive Ki Barrier, gained after each cast. (2) 'Fight his W block' treated Spirit's Refuge as blocking everything; Riot's text says it blocks ATTACKS, so your abilities land through it. (3) Stand United is an interruptible channel and this was never stated.
audit.why: Riot text — P: 'After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield.' W: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' R flagged channel: interruptible, any CC cancels it.
audit.corrected: Cast through Spirit's Refuge instead of walking out of it, attribute the shield to Ki Barrier, and knock him up during Stand United to cancel the teleport outright — the single highest-value use of Cyclone in this matchup.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Shen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Stand United is 200s at rank 1 and shields from anywhere — a slow all-in gets blanked, so kill him before he channels.

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash: matchup-defining — His engage CC. Decoy it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shadow Dash: 18s at rank 1, 600 range — that is your window. - Spirit's Refuge: 16s, and it blocks attacks only, so your abilities still land. - Stand United: 200s, and a knockup cancels the channel.

edits.before: His engage CC. Decoy it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Shadow Dash is 18s at rank 1 — those 18 seconds are your all-in.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not abilities — keep casting through it.

edits.before: Burning W before the trade starts — the clone IS your defense, and committing without it means eating his full combo.
edits.after: Stand United is a channel on a 200s cooldown — knock him up during it and the teleport never happens, so his ally dies.

edits.before: Track Shen's Shadow Dash (Taunt): His engage CC. Decoy it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks autos only — abilities pass through. Shadow Dash is 18s: E-Q and R him then.

edits.before: Shen's global R lets him shield an ally and TP away, so a slow all-in is worthless — his Stand United (R) also blocks your Cyclone knockup value if he ults mid-fight. Commit only with jungle so the fight is over before he recalls the blade.
edits.after: Stand United (R) is 200s at rank 1: he shields an ally and teleports out, so a slow all-in is worthless. It is a channel, though — Cyclone's knockup lands during the cast and the teleport never happens, which is your best use of R at 6.

edits.before: From 3 on Shen edges ahead: his taunt (E) interrupts your Cyclone and his shield (Q) blanks your Q trade, and by 6 his global R makes patient dives pointless. Only commit with a jungler.
edits.after: From 3 on Shen edges ahead: his taunt (E) interrupts your Cyclone and Ki Barrier shields each cast, and by 6 his global R makes patient dives pointless. Only commit with a jungler.

notes: Stand United's 'channel — interruptible, any CC cancels it' flag is consistent with Riot's own 'soon after teleports' wording, so I wrote the knockup-cancels-R line. I did NOT claim tenacity, QSS or spell-shield behaviour anywhere (needsResearch empty = unknown). Wukong's kit came through null again, so Cyclone/Nimbus Strike cooldowns still cannot be added on this page — same gap the mirror audit flagged.
